title: Consultation
description: We start with a deep-dive consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Our experts guide you through possibilities, site constraints, and realistic cost expectations.

title: Planning
description: Detailed project planning including site surveys, soil testing, structural engineering, cost estimation, and regulatory compliance checks. Every detail mapped before we begin.

title: Design
description: Our architects create stunning 3D designs and blueprints, refined iteratively until you are 100% satisfied. We handle DTCP approvals and all permit submissions.

title: Construction
description: Expert execution with premium materials, certified contractors, and real-time progress updates at every milestone. Weekly WhatsApp photo updates keep you informed from anywhere.

title: Handover
description: Final quality inspection, snagging walkthrough, and post-completion support. Your dream home, delivered with complete documentation and post-handover support.
